key_idea: Reduce the global density problem to bounding local scores on decomposition stars, and eliminate all potential counterexamples via a massive computer-assisted exhaustive search.
reason: This is the quintessential brute-force proof, relying entirely on heavy computer calculations, massive case analysis, and tens of thousands of linear programs. It establishes correctness but offers no conceptual explanation or humanly graspable insight into why the result holds.
recognized: Thomas Hales' proof of the Kepler conjecture
